annotations.title: Falsified Medicines Directive (FMD) 2D DataMatrix Serialization Auditor

description:
[Falsified Medicines Directive (FMD) 2D DataMatrix serialization auditor. Pure calculation & parsing, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits medicinal product safety features under Directive 2011/62/EU and Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/161, validating GTIN-14 check digits, randomized serial numbers (<1:10,000 entropy), expiration dates, and anti-tampering seals.
Usage: Pass pharmaceutical packaging identifiers to verify compliance with EMVS European Hub serialization standards.
Returns: JSON object with { medicinalProductName: string, isSerializationCompliant: boolean, gtinCheck: object, serialNumberCheck: object, expirationDateCheck: object, antiTamperingDeviceAudit: object, emvsPayloadRepresentation: object, deficiencies: array }.

antiTamperingDevicePresent.description: Whether packaging incorporates an Anti-Tampering Device (ATD) ex Art. 54a(2)(b)

gtinOrNtin14Digits.description: 14-digit Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) or National Trade Item Number (NTIN)

marketingAuthorisationHolder.description: Name of Marketing Authorisation Holder (MAH) established in EU

medicinalProductName.description: Official proprietary or generic name of the medicinal product for human use

nationalReimbursementNumber.description: National reimbursement or identification code where required by Member State (e.g. AIC, CIP, PZN)

nationalReimbursementType.description: Type of national reimbursement code format

serialNumber.description: Randomized serial number (8-20 alphanumeric characters, guessing probability < 1:10,000)

name: fmd_pharma_serialization_matrix_auditor
title: Falsified Medicines Directive (FMD) 2D DataMatrix Serialization Auditor
